significance.quote: The best-fit point of the reactor antineutrino anomaly is rejected at more than 99.9% C.L.
significance.value: more than 99.9% C.L. (rejection of the RAA best-fit point)

summary.plain: With 179 days of reactor-on data STEREO compared the antineutrino spectra of its six cells and found no sign of oscillation to a sterile neutrino. The best-fit point of the reactor antineutrino anomaly was rejected at more than 99.9 per cent confidence.
summary.technical: Direct comparison of the antineutrino spectra of all cells (largely independent of any flux prediction) with 179 d reactor-on and 235 d reactor-off data: compatible with the null oscillation hypothesis; RAA best fit rejected at > 99.9 % CL.

title: Improved Sterile Neutrino Constraints from the STEREO Experiment with 179 Days of Reactor-On Data
why_it_matters: One of the three reactor experiments (with PROSPECT and DANSS) that closed most of the allowed region for an eV-scale sterile neutrino explanation of the reactor anomaly.
